<user_query>
Explore /home/admin/frontend/src for all code paths that depend on active page keys related to navigation: director, notifications, calendar, students, teachers, course-mgmt, classroom, attendance, learning, subject-units, parent, profile, director-accounts. Identify where navigation is triggered (emit/navigate/setActivePage), any assumptions about group names/titles/icons, and any risks if page labels are renamed but keys stay same. Return concise bullets with file paths and key findings.
</user_query>

I’m going to scan `frontend/src` for every usage of those page keys and navigation handlers (`setActivePage`, emits, navigate), then map where labels/titles/icons are coupled versus key-only logic.

**Preparing parallel code searches**

I’ve located the key touchpoints; next I’ll read `App.vue` plus the few emitter pages to map exact trigger flows and any title/group/icon coupling.

**Planning detailed file inspection**

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`  
  - **Single source of truth for page keys**: `active` state gates all page mounts via `active === '<key>'` (`director`, `notifications`, `calendar`, `students`, `teachers`, `course-mgmt`, `classroom`, `attendance`, `learning`, `subject-units`, `parent`, `profile`, `director-accounts`).  
  - **Primary navigation trigger**: sidebar buttons call `setActivePage(item.page)`.  
  - **Secondary navigation handlers**: `onNavigateFromNotifications({ target })` and `onNavigateToSchedule({ teacherId, target })` set `active` from emitted targets.  
  - **Key-based behavior assumptions**: unread badge only shows when `item.page === 'notifications'`; special calendar reset when page/target is `'calendar'`; password-lock forces `'profile'`.  
  - **Group/title/icon assumptions**: nav groups and items are hardcoded (`title`, `label`, `icon`) in `sidebarNavGroups`; logic uses `page` key, not label/title/icon text.

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/DirectorDashboard.vue`  
  - Navigation outflow: `emit('navigate', { target: 'notifications' })` from “前往通知中心” action.  
  - Copy/text assumptions reference page names in UI text (e.g., hints mentioning specific pages), but routing itself is key-driven.

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/NotificationsCenter.vue`  
  - Navigation outflow: `emit('navigate', { target })` via `goToTarget`.  
  - Key mapping assumption: notification `type` → page key (`pending_swipe -> attendance`, `learning_review -> learning`, `tuition -> course-mgmt`).

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/TeachersList.vue`  
  - Navigation outflow: `emit('navigate-to-schedule', { teacherId, target: target || 'course-mgmt' })`; buttons explicitly send `'course-mgmt'` and `'calendar'`.

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/pageGuideConfig.js`  
  - Full guide config keyed by the same page keys (including `'course-mgmt'`, `'subject-units'`, `'director-accounts'`, etc.).  
  - Strong **title/description copy assumptions** about page names and purpose; these are content-level (tour text), not routing logic.

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/usePageGuideTour.js`  
  - Consumes `pageKey` via `resolvePageGuideSteps(pageKey, context)`; guide behavior depends on stable keys, not labels.

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/Login.vue`  
  - Parent portal shortcut uses URL hash `#/parent`; this is effectively another key-based navigation entry path.

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/ProfileCenterPage.vue`  
  - Uses local tab key `'notifications'` for profile sub-tabs (`activeTab`), independent from app-level `active` page key; naming overlap but isolated scope.

**Rename-risk summary (labels changed, keys unchanged):**
- **Low risk for actual navigation**: app routing and emits are key-based, so label/title/icon renames generally do not break page switching.
- **Medium risk for UX consistency**: hardcoded copy in sidebar labels, guide titles/descriptions, and page hints can become stale/mismatched with renamed labels.
- **Watch-outs**: anything key-specific (e.g., `'notifications'` badge condition, calendar reset on `'calendar'`, notification-type target mapping) is safe only if keys remain unchanged exactly.
